I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random. I confirmed that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, and that this replaces the number they posted in #central-team this morning.

I didn't post or change anything anywhere else, since they said no action was needed. I did suggest they post a correction in #central-team themselves, so people there don't go by the old number.
